courses.name: Why we eat what we eat

_types: The 15 areas are the front page rows (Bryan, 15 Nov 2026: "I like those rows"). A row shows each whole course as one card. A course with "shelf": "supplement" (the mind's mechanisms) shows its units as small cards instead, and any unit anywhere can point to them with "mechanisms": [unit numbers].

practice.name: Mind Gym
practice.what: Short rooms that train the fast, gut part of your thinking: small words, base rates, hidden assumptions, causes and tricks in posts.

rooms.name: Hinge Words
rooms.trains: Catching the small words that decide what a sentence means.

rooms.name: Flag Rooms
rooms.trains: Knowing what a flag from an alarm, a test, a dog or a camera really means.

rooms.name: Sure-o-meter
rooms.trains: Feeling the right amount of sure.

rooms.name: Chunk It
rooms.trains: Holding a whole real system in a few rooms you can see at once.

rooms.name: Hole Finder
rooms.trains: Seeing the hole in an argument at a glance.

rooms.name: Cause Detective
rooms.trains: The snap check on "X causes Y": what else could make the two move together?

rooms.name: Spot the Trick
rooms.trains: Seeing the move a post is making on you before you believe it or share it.

rooms.name: Your Channels
rooms.trains: Knowing how your own inner pictures, voices and feelings work, so each room can start the way that fits you.

_practice: Practice sites the University links to, not copies (Bryan, 20 Nov 2026: "Yes, link it"). Each shows as one card in its area's row; a unit companion { "role": "train", "room": "<id>" } is a Train it piece that opens that room. Room names and lines are copied from the site's own rooms.json; rerun the link script when rooms change.
